FAQ

Quick answers.

Can I get a size that isn't listed?

Yes. Enter your dimensions in the Brick Studio — we'll confirm whether it can be moulded before you order.

How do I work out the quantity?

Open "Calculate from wall size" in step 4 of the Brick Studio. It uses the brick size you picked.

What's the difference between Standard and Premium?

Both are made the same way. Premium bricks are picked out after firing for straighter edges and more even colour.
